phase_contract: After full base Projectile.Init (including real pending queue setup), native derived ArcProjectile.Init copies ArcStart to mAngleOffset(+510). Pure Move planning does not establish initialization, registration, collision or active simulation.
move_order: if World.time > Thing.spawnTime, advance mAngleOffset towards ArcEnd by float32(float64(abs(float32(Data.Speed)))*pi/180)*dt, clamped to endpoint
AttachToOwner true: resolve actual owner; missing owner => native removal true; else real SetLocation(owner.GetLocation,false), SetAngle(ownerBodyAngle or0 + angleOffset)
AttachToOwner false: real SetLocation(spawnLocation + Range*[cos(angleOffset+spawnAngle),-sin(angleOffset+spawnAngle)],false), SetAngle(normalized atan2(-(newY-spawnY),newX-spawnX))
manager_order: flush captured PROJECTILES_TO_ADD order to entity-hash/PROJECTILES and conditional reflected/effector lists
active insertion-vector loop virtual UpdateSelf(dt*Thing.ElapsedTimeMultiplier), reread active length each iteration
native true => mark disposed, hash erase, Thing.Dispose, auxiliary erases, Release; false => stable survivors compaction
new pending during active updates waits next frame; Unit-created shots are promoted and updated later in SAME World frame
arc_update_boundaries: virtual CheckForImpact and final angle endpoint handling
critical_first_sword: SwordWeapon source ProjectileDefenseRadius=235 despite DeflectProjectiles=false; defense scan cannot be replaced by testing DeflectProjectiles alone. Original polygon becomes sweep geometry at native positions; Move alone does not execute hit/damage callbacks.
